rationale: The responses are mostly natural, matching the patient's practical habits, sensitivity to appearing careless, and enjoyment of books. However, repeated wording and consistently tidy, on-topic answers feel somewhat rehearsed and underrepresent the described associative shifts and spontaneous observations.

evidence.quote: Well, it was still a mystery—just in the wrong section.
Getting back to what I was doing takes more effort then.
I don’t want people thinking I’m careless just because I’ve lost my place.
